implemented: Build default voxel membership and adjacency once per frame; recompute connected components on each layer's eligible subgraph.
Share a bounded slot-indexed touched-cell buffer across space construction, visibility and L6; publish cells once in deterministic order.
Use exact relation existence queries and lazy 128-point conservative block bounds with nonunit/extreme/boundary fallback.
Expose optional stage timing and voxel/edge/relation operation counts outside published model evidence.
Add CPU-only cached replay with excluded warm-ups, every measured sample, full normalized four-mode payloads, immutable-input/wrong-sweep checks and evaluator-ready normal output.
Support CPU cached replay in independent SemanticKITTI diagnostics without fabricated engine paths or weakening oracle gates.
Add opt-in local_object_relations to stop propagating object references across an entire scene-connected component.

performance.build_boundary: Both variants optimize fusion module sources identically; cached dependencies retain their settings. Not a whole-stack release build.
performance.runtime: Existing isolated test container, mapped non-root user, shared i7-12700KF host; no inference, GPU fusion, affinity or frequency changes.
performance.protocol: Five interleaved AB/BA process pairs; each frame/mode excludes one warm-up and retains its measured sample. Separate opt-in profiling is not the timing comparison.
performance.attribution_boundary: Block counters compare the earlier exact workspace/existence-query version with the final block version, not the original unoptimized full-scan implementation.
limitations: The earlier seconds-scale fastbuild measurements are not this comparison's baseline; compiler optimization and architecture gains must not be conflated.
Per-frame repeated distributions on three development frames, not population P99, full-pipeline throughput or vehicle deadline acceptance.
Sampled RSS is not a guaranteed peak, memory-growth or leak result.

local_relation_experiment.scope: 12 development NORMAL frames; no ground or semantic-partition changes
local_relation_experiment.interpretation: More local relationship representation with preserved development object metrics, not newly improved detection accuracy or physical unknown-relation truth.

deferred_or_blocked: Full point-evidence SoA conversion remains future work; the current pipeline still uses point protobuf fields internally.
No speculative CPU workers: only 3-5ms of measured space construction could overlap the current dependency chain without further dataflow changes.
GPU remains conditional on CPU/dataflow profiling rather than a substitute for reducing repeated work.
No new ground algorithm is enabled. The previous robust-ground option remains off because additional THING points were classified as ground.
Projection/ray-origin, physical ground-support, vehicle capability and continuous ODOM production contracts remain unresolved. FREE and production temporal integration are not enabled.

artifacts.benchmark_tool_boundary: The frozen selected timing executable predates only the added standard summary/model-copy export; final replay_cached uses identical fusion core and is separately checked against it on all 12 development frames in all four modes.
